goalInOwnWords: Build a line of machines that turns junk into things that sell, fill the money order each shift, and finish with more money than the foreman Sal.
stoppedWhere: The results screen of today's yard (All three stars, $16,023, beat Sal by $3,219) with the survey's completion code card showing.
stoppedWhy: I finished a whole game and got all three stars, and my break was long over. It had taken me about twenty minutes for the lesson and one yard. I would not start another one right now; I would try tomorrow's yard on a day off.

stuck.where: Shift 4 of today's yard, the Plate Press card tagged 'No easy spot yet'
stuck.what: Sal said 'Move a machine to make room' but not how, or what the press needs. When I tapped a machine the press dropped on top of it and my crusher jumped to the shelf, which I did not expect. I could not tell what a press needs in front of it until the forecast said '$128 short: the Plate Press waits for scrap'.
stuck.gotOutHow: Read the 'short of the order' lines, put the Crusher back next to the press, then found Move to shift the hopper. Forecast went to $2,742 and filled the order.

stuck.where: Shift 6 of today's yard, '$4 short of the $4,600 order'
stuck.what: The coach's 'add a hopper' did nothing when I put a hopper over the old crusher (forecast did not move). Nothing said that crusher was already at its limit.
stuck.gotOutHow: Moved the hopper to the glowing spot and placed the crusher and dock Sal lit; forecast $4,869 filled the order.

stuck.where: Turn and Turn back buttons on a placed part
stuck.what: I could not tell which way each button spins a part until I tapped it. Once I turned a crusher away from the press by mistake.
stuck.gotOutHow: Tapped Turn once more and read the 'Sends to the ...' line.

confused: 'On this yard a Tuner already speeds up the Furnace' on the job card means nothing to a newcomer
'From shift 4, plates sell for $42 too' - too what? I never worked out what else sells for $42
'No easy spot yet' on a card does not say what I should do about it
Tapping a machine with a part picked swaps them and sends the old one to the shelf, with no warning
A spare Dock I placed on shift 2 sat there all game with the label 'nothing came' and nobody said to take it away
'Tap the Shipping Dock on the shelf, then where you think it pays' when the Dock was not needed and changed nothing
A green 'Clean' tag on the end screen, clean of what?
The 'Picked:' line on the end screen lists Scrap Hopper four times and reads as if my choices were boring
annoyed: A lot of text on the home screen and on the job card, I skimmed all of it
Shifts 1 to 3 of today's yard were the same move (pick the green card, tap three glowing squares, start) which felt like homework
The bottom half of the phone screen is crowded with small grey text (What things sell for, Start the lesson over, Skip the lesson, Tips)
Rearranging a line on a phone takes many small taps
No leaderboard or way to compare my score with anyone in this test version
The hint 'add a hopper' kept appearing even when it would not help
pleased: Sal tells me one thing at a time and lights the spot, so the lesson was clear and took about the 3 minutes it promised
The 'This shift will pay $X' forecast is exactly right, so I trust it and can try things
Jumping from $37 to $111 to $576 in the lesson shows the point of the machines
The 'short of the order' lines gave real tension in shifts 4, 5 and 6
The coach talking about my own line ('the press sat idle 53 % of the shift') felt like a hint after a guess
The result screen: confetti, three stars, 'You beat Sal by $3,219' and a bar chart of my shifts going up
The game remembered 4x speed so I did not have to set it again
bestMoment: Shift 4: I fixed a line that was $11 short by putting a Crusher in front of the Plate Press, the forecast jumped to $2,742, the shift paid exactly that and the screen said I was $408 ahead of Sal.
worstMoment: Shifts 2 and 3 of today's yard: the same tapping of glowing squares for the third time while the game kept saying I was only level with Sal, and the one choice I was given (where to put a Dock) changed nothing.
oneChange: Let me make a real decision from the first shift of the daily yard, and make the first half much shorter, so a whole yard fits in a ten minute break.
